title: Travel-time tomography from mean field game dynamics
summary: Travel-time tomography seeks to recover a hidden environment from external measurements generated by propagation through an anomalous region. Standard formulations treat propagation as passive, so the environment influences observations mainly by bending paths or changing travel times. Many collective systems do not operate in that regime: observed arrivals are shaped by strategic motion, congestion, and environmental costs.
